title: wallet.credited
description: Published by the ledger when a top-up or refund lands in a client's main wallet (data model §5's Events table), in the same transaction as the posting. One event per main wallet credited. This is the envelope's data field, not the whole envelope (see platform/events.Envelope).

amount_minor.description: The net amount credited to the wallet by this transaction, in minor units.

rail.description: The payment rail the money came in on: the provider-clearing account the posting draws on, e.g. mpesa_ke, or sandbox for a dev top-up (task 5.6). Absent when the posting draws on none, as when staff match a payment out of suspense.
